svg.title: TYPHON / Reproducibility and evidence
svg.desc: Opportunity solution tree, with a separate result box directly to the right of each completed experiment or evidence activity.
svg.text: 12 October 2026 · Results: green = bounded improvement · amber = mixed · rose = negative · blue = evidence · purple = review · Dashed = review or unrun

g.title: Outcome: Personally recorded manipulation data drives reliable Panda feeding and measured loading transfer
Opportunity: I need comparable results that show what actually worked
Solution: Matched evaluations with explicit limitations
Experiment: Earlier 775-rollout comparison EVAL01 · #10995 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: 775 feeding trials reconciled:155 scenes x 5 models, no harness/TTC. On 137 unfinished scenes,70 mm pickups vanilla/V 1/V 2/V 3/V 4=0/0/0/10/1; new upright stable placements=0/0/0/5/1. Original strict passes all started complete.
Experiment: Earlier A/B harness comparison EVAL03 · #10997 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Historical 400 AB rows reconciled:5 models x 2 modes x 20 A/20 B. All strict/pickup/place outcomes 0. Matched initial-state/config hashes retained. Harness had 30 s wall cap and one candidate; noTTC. Budget stops are separated from runtime errors in report/historical-ab 400.json. This synthetic panel is distinct from 775 feeding and the new 136+160 panels.
Experiment: 204 paired rollouts: vanilla / broad 12k / intervention EVAL02 · #10996 REVIEW

Result · review: 136 baseline trials complete: broad12k17/40 near starts,0/20 broad,8/8 already-complete.68 intervention trials unexecuted. EVAL02R reproduces existing family uncertainty; procedural freezing is not pristine holdout.
Review: Research report + independent review OPS03 · #10980 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 13 research requests reconciled with independent and planner review. Model identities, denominator limits and errata documented.
Experiment: Reconcile existing comparison claims EVAL02R · #11036 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: 775 original statistics reproduce exactly;296 later raw episodes and24 earlier extracts agree. Six training takes share two recording pairs. Goal-varied versus fixed:10 gains,0 losses on new combinations; loading0/12. EVAL02 remains136/204.
Solution: Reproducible artifact and model registry
Backup: Weights, traces and recovery backup OPS02 · #10979 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Weights, traces and recovery states preserved with SHA-256 verification on Mint Fast Drive. Backup evidence; no new model-performance result.
Delivery: Research ledger OPS01 · #10956 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 58 original work items recorded with requests, findings, limitations and follow-ups. Administrative evidence; no robot-performance result.
Experiment: Exact model and dataset registry DATA01 · #10986 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Checkpoint and dataset registry saved.19 headers verified, historical M 6 hashes reconciled and three new continuations recorded. V 4 continues V 3; broad-Pt 12 k starts fresh. Native RGB and privileged held/history contracts distinguished.
Experiment: Dashboard + video evidence DEL01 · #11007 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Eight fixed media records trace to scores/actions/model or assisted controller. Ten original/derived videos fully decode and match both archives. Private claims corrected. None matches hosted index; older V4 links remain 404. No publication.
Experiment: Private research synthesis DEL02 · #11008 REVIEW

Result · review: Private synthesis ready: 1,777 words, 14 claim groups, 46 indexed evidence files, 12 method identities, 37 numerical checks. Original report retained in Git. No new runs/publication. Hosting, submission and blocked research remain pending.
Experiment: Draw and verify the research OST OPS05 · #11012 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Five-column OST verified with experiment/result alignment and all historical work retained. Updated12October to include the authorised24-hour plan and B/loading diagnosis.
